name: Indus Towers Ltd
about: Indus Towers Limited is engaged in the business of object of, inter-alia, setting up, operating and maintaining wireless communication towers.[1]
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1] Indus Towers provides shared tower and related infrastructure services. It is one of the largest telecom tower companies in India by No. of towers and co-locations. It leases tower space mainly to wireless telecom operators on a shared basis under long-term contracts.
pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 3.69%.
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -17.7%
